reason: My staff's nota from the building-supply shop are scrawled in pen, half in Indonesian shorthand, often smudged. I might feed the 40 free ones through it to see, but I don't expect it to read them well enough to be worth paying for every month.
objection: Recognition will get the faded handwritten Indonesian receipts wrong and I'll end up checking every row in the sheet anyway, so I'd be paying $19 a month to do the same work twice.
would_change_my_mind: If the free 40 included a pile of our real handwritten nota and it got nearly all the amounts and items right without me fixing anything.
